said: I bought the Lyncott Home Office Desk Chair from 1stopbedrooms.com for $119.89, the lowest of the three offers for that chair ($155.00 at furniturepick.com, $124.00 at afastores.com). The furniturepick.com listing included a note telling shopping agents not to compare prices, which I ignored, since comparing prices is how I could get you the best deal.
